project_type: Full-stack TypeScript: Vite React SPA (frontend) + Express API (backend) on Supabase
build_system: Vite 6 + esbuild for server bundle. Must run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh' before any npm/node commands.
test_framework: No formal test suite. Verification is via TypeScript type-checking (tsc --noEmit) and successful Vite build.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) - should pass with no new errors. 2. Run npm run build (vite build + esbuild server.ts) - should produce dist/ successfully.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Must prefix all npm/node commands with 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh'. Node.js available via nvm. Git push credential helper is configured. GitHub PAT available for API calls.
contribution_requirements: Push to feat/emerald-email-otp branch. PR #1 already exists and will be updated automatically on push.
key_patterns: Components in src/components/*.tsx. Auth context in src/contexts/AppContext.tsx. Server modules in server/*.ts. Entry server.ts creates Express app. API routes under /api/*. Vercel deployment via vercel.json with SPA rewrites. Uses TailwindCSS 4 with @import 'tailwindcss'. Motion (framer-motion) for animations. Lucide-react for icons. Design system in src/index.css with CSS custom properties.
directory_structure: Root: server.ts (dev server), index.html (SPA entry), vercel.json (Vercel config), package.json. src/: App.tsx (main app with tabs/sidebar), components/ (14 portal components), contexts/ (AppContext auth), data/mockData.ts, lib/. server/: app.ts (Express factory), auth.ts (OTP/login/register), data.ts (CRUD), agents.ts (AI chat), security.ts (rate limiting/sessions). api/: Vercel serverless entry.
